acceptance: A boundary under host load does not fail on a single slow REPL boot
A real boot failure still fails loudly with evidence
fix: Make the boot window of the live check adaptive or config-driven (policy), and give the boundary one recovery rung: retry the live check once after a load-aware wait before it fails the boundary. Record the load and the boot time in the failure.
summary: On 2026-10-11, evolve wave next failed two times at step 7 (evolve doctor live claude-tmux): REPL prompt never appeared after 60s, rc=80, after the auto-respond trust keys. The same check passed alone four times, also right after evolve gc. The failures came right after the make build step while 4 lanes ran test suites (load average up to 29). The third wave next passed. A fixed 60 s boot window turns host load into a boundary failure.
title: The wave boundary fails its live claude check under host load (60 s REPL window)
